title: CLI & API access
markdown:
# CLI & API access

Bring Harper Vance performance reports and live target updates into your own workflow. The CLI provides structured output for research, reporting and integration with your existing tools.

CLI access requires an authenticated account with an enrolled authenticator and an active eligible organization. It is included with Desk Intelligence and Firm Wide Enterprise. Entity Core is excluded; custom agreements require an explicit CLI grant. Permissions and history limits are checked by the service on every request.

## Reporting and live data

All interfaces below use GET requests.

| API | What you can retrieve | Parameters |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/cli/product/daily` | Daily performance reports | Required `dates`: YYYY-MM-DD; comma-separated for multiple days |
| `/api/cli/product/weekly` | A weekly performance report | Required `year` and `week`: ISO week year and number |
| `/api/cli/product/monthly` | A calendar-month report | Required `month`: YYYY-MM |
| `/api/cli/product/rolling` | Recent-session performance | Optional `sessions`: 10, 20 or 40 (defaults to 20); optional `endDate` |
| `/api/cli/product/targets` | Current-session targets | Required `date`: current New York date |
| `/api/cli/product/history` | Historical session data | Required `dates`: YYYY-MM-DD; comma-separated for multiple days |
| `/api/cli/product/day-context` | Current-session context | Required `date`: current New York date |
| `/api/cli/product/target-events` | Target lifecycle updates and replay | Required current `date`; optional resume `cursor` |

Dates follow New York reporting time. Historical requests are limited to the history available to your organization. Live interfaces return current-session information; they do not place trades.

## Account and client resources

| API | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/api/cli/access` | Verify your account's CLI access |
| `/api/cli/release` | Retrieve the supported version and integrity information |
| `/api/cli/download` | Download the supported CLI release |
| `/api/cli/docs` | Retrieve the full client guide and collection templates |

These resources also require authentication and eligible-tier access. Installation, sign-in instructions, detailed usage and downloads are available inside the dashboard after access is verified.
